title: My mallworld - the Soul Hospital
content: I first started having dreams in this place after I left the psych hospital a few months ago. Naturally, I started in an area I started calling "The Soul Hospital" It was much like the psych ward I had just been in, but the buildings seemed to have been reclaimed by nature. However, it was still a functional, relatively sanitary hospital. The plant life just made it beautiful. Somewhere in the hospital, there is a large wooden door inside of an oak tree that is growing through the walls. Behind the door is a warmly lit bar and a bookstore or library. I subconsciously associated it with the god Thoth, even though he hasn't been seen yet. The larger campus extends into a college or university of some kind, with beautiful sweeping landscapes. Many of the dormitories and other academic buildings are in small cabins or cottages scattered throughout, or in larger communal apartment buildings. I seem to be spending most of my time in one of the more communal buildings. I remember the construction of the communal building as well, before I started exploring it. (My mind went sillymode™️ though and made the construction appear like it was being built in Minecraft lol) I encounter a lot of different people here. Some people I know. Others I don't. Some people I'm happy to see. Others I'm not. Some people I recognize aren't always who they seem though. Rooms inside of this main building are continuously changing and shifting. There were three rooms inside of one of the buildings that seemed to radiate an extremely dark energy. In one particular dream, I was tasked to find a grimoire that was located in one of the three rooms. They were sparsely furnished yet cluttered, dark, and had an overwhelming sense of dread that felt suffocating. I woke up from that dream with a migraine for about two days, so I hope I don't go there again. This campus is located in a lovely costal city with a bustling downtown area that I don't know much about yet. The roads and highways overlook the ocean, and there is another oak tree tavern located by the roadside. Cat monorails (not kidding) can be taken to less populated areas. This is about all I've discovered so far. Let me know if you've ever seen any of these places!
